title: 'Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi' Movie Second Part Announced
content: The official website of the Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ( Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery ) movie announced the production of a second part on Friday, as well as five additional cast and a second key visual (pictured) for the first movie. The first part premiered in Japan on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Cosplay Trackside Returns to Santa Anita Park on October 24 & 25
content: Cosplay Trackside, an Umamusume- themed cosplay meetup, returns to Santa Anita Park in Arcadia, California, on October 24 and 25, from 12:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. The event coincides with Santa Anita Park’s Japan Family Day, celebrating the racecourse’s partnership with Japan’s Oi Racetrack.
author: Anime Corner

title: Frequent Ghibli Collaborator Joe Hisaishi Named LA Philharmonic's Composer-in-Residence
content: Hisaishi's new role will include composing new works specifically for the orchestra. He will also hold recurring performances at the Hollywood Bowl, The Ford, and the Walt Disney Concert Hall in Los Angeles.
author: ANN

content: One Piece is one of the biggest shonen series to have ever existed, and living up to the genre’s definition, the franchise also has one of the most suitable power systems. Almost every shonen series has a power system that defines its nature.

title: 15 Years Later, A Sci-Fi Classic Returns With New Crunchyroll Dub Release
content: It’s already been more than 15 years since Steins;Gate made its debut, but the anime has only just begun streaming the English dub. As the largest anime streaming platform around the world, Crunchyroll is home to over a thousand anime shows and movies.

title: K Manga Adds Shinobu Ohtaka's Geekrown Manga
content: Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Thursday that it is adding Shinobu Ohtaka 's Geekrown (also known as Geek and Crown ) manga on October 26. The manga launches on Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app on October 27.

title: One Piece Teases Jump Festa 2027 With New Update
content: Shueisha is gearing up for one of the biggest events of the year, Jump Festa, which is always held toward the end of the year. With One Piece being one of the conglomerate’s biggest manga franchises, it has a major lineup planned.
